title: Lamb Confit with Garlic Mashed Potatoes
description: A classic French dish featuring tender lamb confit, served with a side of rich garlic mashed potatoes.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, then remove it from the pot.
Add the minced garlic, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover it with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2-3 hours, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the garlic mashed potatoes.
Boil the chopped potatoes in salted water until they're tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Stir in the minced garlic and adjust the seasoning as needed.
To serve, slice the lamb confit and serve it with the garlic mashed potatoes.
